notes.title: Retrovamp minor update
notes.notes:
Here is a list of the patch notes:

[list]
[*] In some rare occasions players were unable to spawn checkpoints, this bug has been fixed
[*] Fixed a minor bug that prevented the scoreboard to be correctly updated
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the volume options to be saved
[*] Player controller minor value tweaks
[/list]

Remember to join the official discord server at: https://discord.gg/zJ9ysw2
